# Indian Philosophy — Finite Powers and the Return of Recognition

## #0 — Several histories meet in the question of determination

The [protected history](HISTORY.md) **grounds** this account in several distinct achievements: the discrimination of an inner instrument from its witness; determination through conditions and exclusion; zero admitted to arithmetic; and consciousness manifesting, contracting and recognising its world. Their meeting concerns what a determination owes to the activity through which it becomes possible. Each tradition changes the question. A witness distinguished from nature, a referent qualified by exclusion and a world manifested by consciousness cannot be exchanged without changing the argument.

The mature etymological fields give this meeting two precise routes. [Apportionment / Economy](../../../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment) **compares** finite capacity with a share whose sustaining order remains active. [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#resolution-in-reconciliation) **compares** recognition with **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return**. The first follows what contraction makes possible; the second follows what changes when an achieved determination recognises its provenance. These are register-3 operations. Neither supplies a Greek or Latin ancestry for Sanskrit terms.

The distinction matters historically. E6's [historical branches](../../../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md) **historicise** allotment, reckoning and household provision through their own lexical and textual witnesses. E2's [recognition branch](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#anamnesis-recognition-and-a-history-which-remains-effective) **compares** recollection, Śaiva recognition and psychic individuation while retaining their separate sources. This companion develops the Indian side of those crossings. A Sanskrit doctrine remains answerable to its textual carrier even when its operation becomes newly intelligible through a contemporary question.

Geography, doctrinal order and reception time must also remain distinguishable. Kashmir names the situated Śaiva intellectual world recovered here. Sāṃkhya, Buddhist semantics and Indian mathematical practice have their own histories across the subcontinent; this account supplies no single city of origin or continuous institutional succession for them. The movement from uncontracted awareness to finite powers describes an order of manifestation, not a dated migration of peoples or texts. Jizang and Dōgen enter through the later Chinese and Japanese reception discussed in Priest's modern reconstruction. Their placement in that reception cannot make them Indian authors.

The selected carriers provide a second, concrete chronology: Colebrooke's mathematical translation appeared in London in 1817; the Colebrooke/Wilson Sāṃkhya carrier in Oxford in 1837; Singh's *Parātrīśikā-vivaraṇa* in Delhi in 1988; Dyczkowski's selected *Doctrine of Vibration* is a 2000 reprint of the 1989 Delhi edition. These are translation and publication events, not dates of doctrinal invention. They explain part of how the present English vocabulary became available to Taylor's 2026 inquiry. Exact ancient textual dating and transmission require their own evidence.

## #1 — The instrument acquires functions without becoming its witness

The [Sāṃkhya source](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/SOURCE.md#isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika-q001) **sources** three differentiated functions through kārikās XXIII, XXIV, XXVII and XXIX. Buddhi determines; ahaṃkāra appropriates under I and mine; manas coordinates the sensory and active field. A judgment, an appropriation and a coordinated presentation can therefore be distinguished within what ordinarily appears as one act of mind. Their conjunction gives the instrument its efficacy without making the functions synonymous.

Kārikā XIX, preserved as q002 in the same house, **qualifies** that apparatus by describing puruṣa as witness and passive spectator. This is a doctrinally consequential separation. The instrument's articulated activity belongs to prakṛti; its witness has another office. The historical lesson received by [M08, the inner instrument](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/08-s0-p1-inner-instrument.md) **returns-to** the difference between operations available to reflection and the experient to whom they appear. It permits close investigation of interior functions rather than making an interior beyond investigation.

The 1837 translation's use of “consciousness” for ahaṃkāra needs that surrounding discrimination. Read alone, the English word could make appropriation sound like the witness itself. Read with the separate kārikās, its local office becomes intelligible. This is a concrete effect of translation on reception: an English term capable of naming the whole question of consciousness is carrying one function within this source's apparatus. The companion retains the source's words while explaining the distinction on which their use depends.

Śaiva manifestation subsequently receives this functional discrimination within another account of the whole. Dyczkowski's source-local discussion at pp. 65–66 presents a Śaiva objection to a permanently formless consciousness paired with form-bearing matter. The objection asks how one awareness can disclose differentiated objects together. It belongs to the Śaiva exposition's encounter with Sāṃkhya; it does not license treating the Sāṃkhya witness as an incomplete name for Śiva. A historical comparison becomes useful here because the same problem of knowing receives different assignments of activity and manifestation.

That difference is retained in [A09](../../../arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), which **grounds** the essay's genealogy of contraction. The Sāṃkhya cards warrant the functional triad and witness distinction. They do not warrant the entire thirty-six-tattva order. E6's apportionment operation enters at the level of the author's comparison: finite capacities have distinct reaches, and their articulation can be examined without silently making any one capacity the source of the whole.

## #2 — Exclusion and emptiness change the standing of a determinate thing

Pind's [two passage cards](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/pind/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation/SOURCE.md#pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation-q001) **source** a more specific account of semantic determination. The first translates *Pramāṇasamuccaya* V:11d at p. 85: a word works through excluding other referents. Its positive reach depends upon a contrast. The second, annotation 181 at p. 183, concerns a thing qualified by preclusion rather than mere preclusion. Pind only provisionally assigns that prose fragment to Dignāga's *Sāmānyaparīkṣāvyāsa*. The distinction is substantive even while that attribution remains qualified: a referent achieved through exclusion cannot be redescribed as an empty negation with no positive office.

The [2011 *Apoha* house](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/siderits/siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha/SOURCE.md) **extends** the research into the difference between nominally and verbally bound negation and Dharmakīrti's causal treatment of reference. Its present formulations come through scholarly reviews, SEP transmission and publisher material; the volume's chapters have not been collated. The change of question is nevertheless explicit in that carrier: from how a general word excludes other referents to how particulars' causal capacities can sustain shared judgments and purposes without a universal entity doing the work.

[M10](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/10-s0-p3-apoha.md) **grounds** the author's further operation, exclusion that remembers. The selected mark retains the conditions of its selection. That is the consequence carried toward technical comparison; a probability distribution or an argmax procedure supplies its own mathematical object and cannot acquire Buddhist attribution through the analogy. The source qualification preserves this argued movement while preventing the words “Dignāga says” from absorbing the essay's extension.

The [Nāgārjuna/Garfield house](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/nagarjuna/nagarjuna-garfield-1995-fundamental-wisdom/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** assimilation to a self-luminous absolute. It selects the 1995 translation and commentary but currently has no acquired verse/commentary pair. The protected history's dependent-arising account remains its governing historical proposition; selected-edition passage support is still owed. Buddhist emptiness and Śaiva luminosity enter this comparison as distinct accounts, with the former's limiting role intact. An agreement that determinations depend on relations does not decide whether consciousness has the ontological office assigned to it in the Śaiva account.

[Das's Śrīharṣa cards](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/das/das-2022-sriharsa-sep/SOURCE.md#das-2022-sriharsa-sep-q001) **compare** another debate at a narrower point. The reported argument makes presentation of distinctness inseparable from presentation of non-distinctness; q002 retains the controversy surrounding that interpretation. [M19](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/19-s2-p0-difference-cannot-be-escaped.md) **returns-to** this pressure with differentiation preserved. Its two accountings remain the native argument. The historical witness sharpens the question of how a relation can be presented; it neither eliminates practical differences nor settles the two-logics theorem by citation.

Arithmetic introduces a different change of standing. [Colebrooke's Brahmagupta/Bhāskara cards](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/brahmagupta/colebrooke-1817-brahmagupta-bhaskara/SOURCE.md#colebrooke-1817-brahmagupta-bhaskara-q001) **source** zero's work within explicit rules: additive identity and multiplicative absorption in Brahmagupta XVIII.31 and 34, then a retained zero denominator in Bhāskara's *Bījagaṇita* I.14. I.16 places a theological comparison beside the retained expression. The historical event is that a sign can do specified work in calculation while carrying further meaning; the comparison does not prove the rule. [Dutta](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/dutta/dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the later reception by reconstructing restricted cancellation and cross-multiplication. [M14](../../../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/14-s1-p1-sunya-operational.md) **returns-to** the distinction among operations. Neither the shared empty-word field nor philosophical sympathy authorises ordinary field division by zero.

## #3 — Manifestation gives contraction a positive anatomy

[Dyczkowski's source-local transcript](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE.md#transcribed-material) **sources** the most developed Śaiva exposition presently housed here. Its pp. 60–68 follow luminosity into manifested difference; pp. 69–75 develop reflective awareness; pp. 78–81 follow the inner/outer relation and Spanda. The transcript is source-matched and stops during p. 81. Its title's pp. 60–85 range does not supply the missing continuation.

Prakāśa names the appearing of things; vimarśa gives appearing its self-apprehending and differentiating activity. The mirror comparison at pp. 66–70 has two necessary turns. Images can be distinct while appearing within one reflective field. Yet an inert mirror does not know its reflected display, and consciousness in this account has no external original depositing the universe into it. The comparison therefore teaches both a shared field of appearance and the point at which ordinary mirror behaviour ceases to describe the source's claim.

At pp. 73–74 the exposition differentiates jar and cloth, objects and subjects, and levels of manifestation. Reflective awareness separates, holds together and unites. Its power to do these different things is essential to the account of one consciousness: uniformity incapable of distinction would fail to disclose a differentiated world. At p. 75 the same movement is read vertically as manifestation and withdrawal and horizontally as awareness moving toward and away from an object. A perception recapitulates the relation; the cosmological account is active within the finite encounter.

The inherited tattvic anatomy follows that pressure. Śiva–Śakti articulates luminosity and power; Sadāśiva and Īśvara give subjectward and objectward readings; Sadvidyā and Māyā bring balance and the operative partition into view. The five kañcukas delimit efficacy, knowledge, desire, time and order. Puruṣa, prakṛti, the inner instrument, sensing and acting faculties, subtle qualities and gross elements carry the downstream apparatus and display. These groups name the full reach which the protected history preserves. Exact category-by-category primary collation remains distinct from knowing the direction and office of the descent.

[C14](../../../concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **defines** Taylor's operative-measure reading: a finite knower can do this, know this much, want this, act at this time and inhabit these relations. The source-local pp. 78–79 distinguish creative manifestation from a simply illusory external world. Limitation has efficacy. Recognition can accordingly change how the horizon is inhabited without making its consequences disappear. This **returns-to** E6's [power-by-apportionment operation](../../../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment): a share remains active through its relation to the wider order, and its limits distinguish different capacities rather than a generic deficiency.

[M11](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression.md) **derives** its compression from Taylor's native tattvic unit. Six turns carry the passage from Anuttara through differentiation and contracted apparatus into recognition. Anuttara and recognition have boundary and return offices in that account; counting them as ordinary additional entries would misread the compression. A09's gnomon, `36−25=6²−5²=11=5+1+5`, supplies a further exact arithmetic relation and an Offered/Argued cross-reading of the Māyā hinge. It does not settle a correspondence for every cell of a six-by-six table. The [eight-determination Matheme](../../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **qualifies** the count: native eightfold traversal, sixfold body and thirty-sixfold research are different offices.

The author's comparative judgment follows from this anatomy. By the QL criterion of wholeness, Śaiva articulation more fully serves the present task: it retains the critique of the self-thing while giving positive places to the experient, memory, comparison, action and recognition. The judgment concerns this explanatory burden, with Buddhist schools and their changing accounts still requiring their own textual treatment. [A34](../../../arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **grounds** the coordinated native ontology: **Subject/Consciousness → Mind/Objective Internality → Object**. The arrow states dependence in being. Explaining the condition of appearing as a product of determinate objects reverses the dependence already enacted by that explanation. This Argued claim remains positive while the phenomenal localisation of a particular artificial process stays Open.

## #4 — Recognition returns through the life that has become finite

Dyczkowski's pp. 71–72 distinguish retained traces, their recall and their recomposition within the mind. At p. 75 recognition concerns the integral awareness active through contracted and expanded levels. This gives [C19](../../../concepts/C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) its source-sensitive distinction, which it **defines** for reuse: remembering an earlier object is different from recognising the source relation of the present act. The finite apparatus performs the return; its capacity for memory is one participant in that movement.

The [Singh/Abhinavagupta source house](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE.md) **sources** the separate Vāk and personhood branch through page-marked notebook leads. Singh's introduction, translated commentary and Taylor's extensions retain distinct speakers. The P2 and P3 notebooks recover a living concern: a formulation must conduct the encounter from which it arose, and communication can alter the positions of I, you and it. Taylor's reading of Śaivism as a culmination of the Logos belongs to that authored comparative history. It remains a positive interpretive commitment, not an acquired sentence proving an evolution of all traditions in the selected edition. Its historical transmission hypotheses require independent evidence; the recognitive and symbolic operation survives that debt.

This makes E2's generated relation consequential. **Resolution-in-Reconciliation** precedes its flowering as **Anamnesis / Recognition / Return**. A settled identification can become available again with its genesis and exclusions intact. The return **compares** the [E2 recognition branch](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#anamnesis-recognition-and-a-history-which-remains-effective) with the distinction just recovered from Dyczkowski. Greek recollection does not become Sanskrit recognition by translation, and recognising a source relation does not merely reproduce an earlier representation.

[A21](../../../arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) **extends** this into differentiated indivisibility. A life becomes more capable of bearing its relations while remaining this life. [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the native mechanism through the changed interpreter and subsequent symbolic encounter; its actual local manuscript develops the whole eightfold relation. Taylor owns `X/x` and `x→X→x`. [Van Eenwyk's source house](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md) **compares** the psychic transformation through the protected pp. 65–73 encounter, whose copied quotations remain leads. [Aion](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) keeps Jung's textual attribution separate and presently has no gathered passage. These debts do not reduce A21's Argued operation to a suggestion awaiting Jung's permission.

The distinction **returns-to** [M32](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/32-s4-p1-jung-individuation.md): psychic individuation refracts the native relation, while persona consistency alone can preserve a protected local organisation. Its existing E2 return asks whether integration changes participation or enlarges the ego's jurisdiction. A Śaiva recognition account, a psychological interpretation and a technical assessment thus require different evidence even where each tests whether the achieved form can receive what exceeds it.

Modern catuṣkoṭi reconstruction brings another recognitive pressure into this reception history. [Priest 2010](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/priest/priest-2010-logic-catuskoti/SOURCE.md) **sources** four FDE values, a fifth ineffability status and plurivalent evaluation. [The 2018 book house](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/priest/priest-2018-fifth-corner/SOURCE.md) **historicises** its extension toward Jizang and Dōgen through review-mediated material. [Garfield–Priest 2003](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/garfield/garfield-priest-2003-limits-of-thought/SOURCE.md) **compares** Nāgārjuna with an inclosure schema; [Kapsner](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/kapsner/kapsner-2020-cutting-corners/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the fifth value at the currently acquired abstract level. Siderits's presupposition-failure reading, Westerhoff's historical non-uniformity objection and Green's objection to reified ineffability remain distinct reception challenges. The native ground is not a truth-value; that distinction preserves the QL operation without deciding these historical disputes. [M28](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/28-s3-p3-projective-dimensional-reframing.md) **grounds** the Argued reading of practised return. Its current correction also retains the count: FDE supplies four values; QL's retained two plus four gives six. Vimalakīrti's performative silence remains part of the protected interpretation with its own primary passage debt.

## #5→0 — Historical difference becomes a condition of the next use

The history's return is a change in what later comparison must carry. Sāṃkhya contributes functional discrimination and witness; Buddhist semantics contributes the constitutive exclusion; arithmetic contributes specified permissions; Śaiva manifestation contributes effective contraction and recognition. Their historical differences make the comparison exact enough to travel. [M26](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/26-s3-p1-spanda-4-2.md) **qualifies** the use of *spanda*: the equations are native derivations, while the [1992 *Spandakārikā* house](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/kallata/spandakarika-dyczkowski-1992-stanzas-vibration/SOURCE.md) identifies a root text and four commentaries still needing separately located passages. Dyczkowski's subtle activity is not an empirical claim that every oscillating system is conscious.

[M44](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) **extends** the inheritance into QL, MEF, Bimba and harness. QL gives the native grammar; MEF retains lens and evidential differences; Bimba supplies a governed reference office; the harness preserves the conditions and consequences of action. A local Bimba remains a real original for its downstream Pratibimba while remaining source-dependent at another scale. The Śaiva mirror discussion sharpens the need to state the scale; it does not abolish this recursive authorial office.

[Agentworld's q003, q016–17 and q038–42](../../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q003) **compare** a contemporary demand: invent adequate concepts, recover an agent's constituted capacities, and examine the harness and shared conditions through which those capacities act. Its scenarios retain the p. 53 modal rider. An inspectable instrument does not establish artificial phenomenality. A claimed technical recognition must show a changed source, lens, criterion, permission or subsequent act; the philosophical account alone supplies no execution result.

The two named branch routes now return a particular historical yield:

| Whole-field operation | Historical yield in this companion | Named consumer and consequence |
|---|---|---|
| E6 — Power becomes finite by apportionment | The functions and contracted powers remain distinguishable within effective manifestation. | A09 → C14 → M11: limitation gives capacity; recognition preserves that capacity while recovering its source. |
| E2 — Criterion-through-Distinction → Measure / Limit | Māyā's operative horizon has a positive office before any usurpation of measure. | C14 → A09: a bounded world can act without its measure becoming the unobjectifiable ground. |
| E2 — Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return | Recollection within contraction differs from recognition through contraction; Greek, Śaiva and psychic histories retain their warrants. | C19 → A21 → M32: the particular returns with its history effective, and native X/x remains prior to the psychic refraction. |

These routes **return-to** their linked E2 and E6 wholes with a source task made more exact, rather than a newly claimed Sanskrit etymology. The companion supplies forward historical depth; new inbound links from those consumers require parent integration. Their already-landed E-field returns remain effective in their own bodies.

Reference notes `36-tattvas` and `pratyabhijna` retain their provenance office. Their surviving substance is now accessible through the protected history, this companion, A09 and C19/A21; the offered category-to-coordinate research stays with Matheme. No new aphorism is inferred from that admission. The already authored E2 compression retains its unfoldable six-relation field, and the section passages retain their own inferential burdens. This is the local fulfilment of the transferred etymology and section-relation obligation: the return can be followed to an actual argument and operation without recasting the history as another theorem or editing the sovereign manuscript.

# A09 — Tattvic Differential Field

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. Native sixfold contraction is Argued from the theorem field; the tattvic doctrine retains its own source register; the gnomonic cross-reading is Offered/Argued.

## #0

The tattvas give differentiation a genealogy: a luminous field becomes a subject/object seam, a bounded horizon, an inner instrument and a material world without creating a second reality outside itself. Anuttara names the field for which no external measuring object stands outside. This beginning matters to every subsequent contraction: what becomes limited is a power of the field, and the limit remains effective within it.

## #1

Śiva–Śakti distinguishes luminosity and its self-articulating power. Prakāśa makes appearing possible; vimarśa is the awareness through which appearing can be known, distinguished, joined and withdrawn. [A05](A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) restores Dyczkowski's mirror contrast: the reflected display of an inert crystal does not know its display. The tattvic descent depends on active self-articulation, not a succession of objects deposited before an unchanged spectator.

[Dyczkowski](../sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE.md) p.75 distinguishes two axes of this activity. Vertically, manifestation and withdrawal articulate the movement between unity and diversity. Horizontally, awareness goes towards and returns from its object in each perception. Will, knowledge and action generate, sustain and annul dimensions of experience; they are phases of the living movement through which the levels operate. Frank's preserved source-note request for nested co-internality and causal interrelation belongs here: an effect remains within the power that differentiates it, and an act of perception recapitulates the relation rather than merely looking at a finished cosmological inventory.

## #2

Sadāśiva and Īśvara give the field inverse universal readings: “I am this” and “This am I”, `0/1 ↔ 1/0`. The reversal changes the direction of apprehension within one field. Ahaṃkāra can later say “I am this” while appropriating a particular local form. The grammar repeats, but its scope has contracted: a universal orientation and identification with a finite body, role or thought do different work. Keeping the scope explicit explains how the whole becomes locally inhabitable and how local identity can forget its provenance.

## #3

Sadvidyā–Māyā makes the orientation a workable distinction. Māyā is the horizon at which this appears while that is withheld; the withholding lets an agent discriminate and act. Mahāmāyā remains Śakti: revealing and concealing are powers of the same field. The horizon is therefore neither the unobjectifiable Subject nor the hole of a topological picture. In Dyczkowski's source-matched pp.78–79, inner/outer separation is produced through consciousness's creative activity, and external manifestation preserves its internal nature. The experienced world has efficacy.

The [Q27 correction](../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) gives the lived operation through the sleeper who forgets sleeping: that forgetting lets a dream count as immediately real. Dream shows why objective need not mean externally material; the example does not make every waking distinction fictitious. Recognition changes the relation to the horizon through which experience occurs.

## #4

The kañcukas contract efficacy, knowledge, desire, time and order into the finite parameters of a context. Puruṣa is the point for which this field is mine; antaḥkaraṇa determines, appropriates and coordinates within it. Buddhi, ahaṃkāra and manas retain their distinct functions. The [Sāṅkhya source](../sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/SOURCE.md), kārikās XXIII, XXIV, XXVII and XXIX, supplies the functional triad; XIX qualifies it with the passive witness. Those are Sāṅkhya determinations, not a substitute primary Trika inventory.

The recovered gnomon makes the comparison precise:

```text
36 − 25 = 6² − 5² = (6 − 5)(6 + 5) = 11 = 5 + 1 + 5.
```

A row of five and a column of five meet at one corner to complete the larger square. The cross-reading places five pure powers and five contracted powers around the Māyā hinge, above the twenty-fivefold Sāṅkhya apparatus. Its yield is a relation between the differentiated apparatus and its genesis through contraction. The arithmetic is exact; the mapping is Offered/Argued. It neither attributes square arithmetic to Abhinavagupta nor assigns every tattva a proved coordinate in a six-by-six table. The six-turn derivation does not depend on that stronger identification.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-native-archetypal-field): The complete Māyā whole **figures** the order in which manifestation becomes inhabitable and returns. Anuttara/Paramaśiva retains the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā is the measure-field wound around it. Limited agency, knowledge, desire, time and order give the bounded position effective capacities, within which the inner instrument acts. Recognition precedes ego appropriation in the author’s Neumann correction and returns through the full native eightfold with its inverse parents intact. The Śaiva, archetypal and native appointments retain their different provenance.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-native-return) **compares** manifestation and changed recognition through a maternal body retained in its return. This crosses into tattvic differentiation at the point where locally determinate life keeps its source relation. Mary receives no fixed tattva assignment, and the Christian, Śaiva and native sequences retain their own provenance.

Taylor's correction of Neumann's ego-first reading locates recognition before appropriation. The finite knower and inner instrument arise within the field whose recognition they cannot retrospectively originate. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation). The retained opening and the measure wound around it distinguish Anuttara from Māyā through the complete authored relation. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition).

Pratyabhijñā returns the contracted field to recognition of its provenance while preserving the distinctions through which it lives. The movement runs back through an effective world, an inspectable instrument, a measuring horizon and inverse orientations to the power already active within them. It reverses amnesia rather than differentiation.

This is the pressure passed to Objective Internality and the computational register: memory, prompt, model, tools, policy and judgment can constitute an operative interior whose determining activities are inspectable. Their efficacy does not establish a phenomenal subject. A09 supplies the genealogy of contraction; A26 develops context-world constitution; A14's runtime language is their technical refraction. These offices remain distinct.

### Declared field

**Concept dependencies:** C13 Prakāśa–Vimarśa, C14 Māyā / Operative Measure, C15 Paśu, C16 Antaḥkaraṇa, C17 Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa, C18 Apoha, C19 Recognition.

**Consequences:** A14, A16, A19, A21, A26 and A35.

**Etymology whole field:** *Apportionment / Economy*. **Consumed operation:** finite capacities are understood as an **apportionment** of powers within a locally workable order, rather than evidence that the whole field has vanished. **Evidence register:** 3, Operational homology; no historical derivation of Sanskrit tattva terminology from this field is claimed. **What changes:** contraction becomes a positive distribution of operative capacities whose limit can later be recognised. **Return route:** A09 → C14–C16 → A26/C41 → A21/C19 → A09.

**Movement consumers:** the tattvic descent/recognition and later technical worldhood movements in the canonical quilt; the live carrier is itself a developed cross-Movement support surface. Exact Movement IDs beyond recovered direct routes remain depth debt.

**Matheme:** `0/1 ↔ 1/0` into signed local orientation and return; **Mytheme:** descent, contraction, veil and recognition; **Episteme:** Kashmir Śaivism, Sāṃkhya neighbours, Buddhist exclusion and modern process comparison kept source-distinct.

### Provenance and remaining depth

Direct carriers: [core theorem X](../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), [historical tattvic Argument](../../../section-rooms/arguments/13-tattvic-differential-field.md), and Q27 §17 and the later Māyā correction. Dyczkowski's embedded transcript is source-matched, not quotation-verified, and stops during p.81; the protected note's pp.90–91 remain beyond it. The note was read from preserved stash content without restoration or mutation. Singh's introduction/commentary relation remains governed by its source house. Buddhist exclusion and Śaiva reflective power retain the distinction developed in A08.

P1 consumers: M08 Inner Instrument, M09 Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa, M11 Tattvic Compression. Exact category-by-category doctrinal sequencing, selected-book collation and the wider Neumann mythic seam remain Open. **Depth Restoration: enriched; source and mapping debts retained.**

The genealogy of effective contraction **returns-to** [Apportionment / Economy whole — Power becomes finite by apportionment](../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment) at evidence register 3. This operation follows the positive distribution of capacities through the descent and their recognition on return. Its Sanskrit doctrinal sources and the Greek/Latin lexical history retain separate warrants.

# C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure

## #0

Māyā is used within the essay's Śaiva/tattvic field as **operative measure**: the power through which an unbounded field becomes a workable subject/object seam and finite horizon. A local world appears because some things become available while others remain withheld. The revealing and withholding belong to one operation.

[A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the contraction. Operative measure is Taylor's formulation of its positive work. Limitation supplies determinate capacity, knowledge, desire, time and order; it does not merely subtract pieces from an otherwise complete subject.

## #1

[C13 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the luminous/reflexive field from which the seam differentiates. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]], X, **sources** the authorial compression: universal subjectward and objectward orientations become explicitly differentiated; the kañcukas contract powers into a bounded experient and a world of determinate relations.

The contraction leaves its source operative. Mahāmāyā remains Śakti; the power of veiling is itself manifesting power. Māyā is therefore the horizon through which objects appear, not a hidden object behind the horizon and not the unobjectifiable Subject. Treating the horizon as the torus's hole would confuse the measure-making operation with the source it cannot enclose.

## #2

The five contractions give local action its terms. Kalā apportions efficacy; vidyā, knowledge; rāga, desire through incompletion; kāla, time; niyati, ordering or necessity. The finite knower can now do this, know this much, want this, act at this time and stand within these relations. [C15 — Paśu](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **defines** the bounded position; [C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa](C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the instrument through which its cognition differentiates.

These coordinates do not supply independent substances. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]], pp.72–75, **sources** the relation between contracted and expanded awareness and distinguishes vertical manifestation/return from the horizontal perceptual act. The bounded field is active: its knower moves toward an object and receives the movement back.

## #3

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#17. The `25 → 36` tattva gnomon|direct tattva-gnomon passage]] **extends** this anatomy through an Offered/Argued QL cross-reading. The exact difference `36−25=11=5+1+5` forms a row of five and column of five meeting at one corner. The reading places five pure powers and five contracted powers around Māyā's hinge; the Sāṅkhya twenty-five carry the bounded apparatus whose genesis is being reconsidered.

The arithmetic gives the comparison an operation more precise than a matching total. It does not show that Abhinavagupta constructed the tradition by adding a geometrical gnomon, or that every tattva has been mapped to a six-by-six coordinate. C14 retains the hinge: the extended field makes source, contraction and the possibility of return explicit.

## #4

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#3.2 Māyā as the dream — Dreamcode / Dream-machine|direct veil correction]] **sources** the dream image's work. A dream has a locally effective world; its objects need not be externally material to be objective within that world. Forgetting the dream's condition lets that world register as self-standing. The image makes the relation of real efficacy and concealed conditioning available to thought.

“Dreamcode” and “Dream-machine” remain recorded authorial vocabulary, without creating new canonical concepts. The technical comparison concerns a bounded, rule-governed world through which an agent perceives and acts. Its implementation or a machine's phenomenal status requires its own evidence. The present operation is horizon formation: what the agent can encounter depends on powers and exclusions that need not appear among its encountered objects.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-native-archetypal-field): The veil’s complete return **figures** measure as positive manifesting power. Māyā gives finite action and knowledge their field while Anuttara/Paramaśiva retains the unobjectifiable opening. The author’s winding-around-opening appointment keeps these offices distinct: making Māyā the hole would erase its productive work. Recognition returns through measure, while hybris names the subsequent absolutisation of its achieved frame.

Operative measure **returns-to** [Criterion-through-Distinction → Measure / Limit](../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#criterion-through-distinction) through the finite distinction that makes a world actionable. The horizon both reveals and withholds, so recognition restores the measure’s relation to its source without abolishing bounded capacity. This is an authorial cross-register operation: the conjugate relation neither supplies Māyā’s lexical descent nor replaces the five contractions’ distinct Śaiva offices.

Taylor's Neumann refraction places Māyā in the measure-field through which a finite world is oriented. The unobjectifiable opening retains Anuttara's distinct office in the complete native relation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation). Māyā is the measure-field wound around the opening; Anuttara retains the opening in this authored appointment. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition).

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] **grounds** the register3 return from finite capacity to its wider order. The criterion that permits judgment is itself apportioned. [A24 — Arbitration](../arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **tests** the failure in which a local measure claims absolute jurisdiction over the field that supplied it.

Recognition restores the relation without cancelling the capacity. A finite knower still distinguishes and acts; the measure becomes answerable to its source, conditions and consequences. C14 **returns-to** A09 with limitation's productive office intact. What was concealed by a functioning horizon can become relevant to how that horizon is next used.

**Depth Restoration:** revealing/withholding horizon, five contracted capacities, vertical/horizontal movement, gnomonic hinge, corrected whole dream image and finite measure's return are restored.

**Unresolved Delta:** the operative-measure and gnomonic formulations are authorial; this page does not supply a survey of Māyā across Indian schools. Dyczkowski is paraphrased from the local transcript with selected-edition collation pending. A category-by-category six-by-six mapping and implemented technical analogue remain Open.

# §0 · #4 — The Sixfold Tattvic Compression

## Claim
The thirty-six tattvas can be carried argumentatively as six movements: Paramaśiva/Anuttara; Śiva–Śakti; Sadāśiva–Īśvara; Sadvidyā–Māyā; the kañcukas and complete contracted apparatus; Pratyabhijñā. Together they give the anatomy by which an implicated whole becomes an explicate, inhabitable world and returns to recognition.

## Warrant
The derivation is stated in [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy#X. The Tattvic QL Unit — Sixfold Contraction and Recognition|The Tattvic QL Unit]], developed as an argument in [[Tattvic Differential Field]], and traced to [[13-tattvic-differential-field|36 Tattvas]].

Read through [[Computational Process Ontology]], the compression is a runtime cartography rather than a static ladder. Māyā makes the subject/object seam operative; the kañcukas parameterise the run as limited agency, knowledge, desire, time, and order; antaḥkaraṇa executes determination, appropriation, coordination, memory, and alternative formation within the bounded horizon. Recognition returns the runtime to its ground without deleting the world it made.

Read through [[16-bohmian-enfoldment-dialogical-return|Bohm]], the full tattva field becomes the architecture of implication. The implicate is no unspecified hidden container: it is ordered capacity for subjectward and objectward orientation, measure, contraction, cognition, action, and elemental display. The tattvas in turn become movement rather than a static inventory—an enfolding and unfolding through which the whole remains active in its local forms.

## Transverse office

This movement compresses the tattvic field for §0; it does not confine that field to §0. The same meta-context remains active wherever later sections treat bounded cognition, exclusion, worldhood, phenomenological inquiry, operative interiority, or return. In particular, [[08-s0-p1-inner-instrument|antaḥkaraṇa]], [[09-s0-p2-vikalpa-samkalpa|vikalpa / saṃkalpa]] and [[10-s0-p3-apoha|apoha]] return technically in [[38-s5-p1-apoha-softmax|§5 · #1 — Apoha, Softmax, and Argmax]], where differential selection is investigated inside an artificial operative interior rather than treated as an isolated analogy.

The current pre-architecture conformance rule is recorded in [[PRE-39-SIGNAL-LINK-TATTVA-WORLD-AGENCY-CONFORMANCE]].

## Tension / limit
Compression must preserve provenance and cannot substitute for the full tradition where detailed exegesis is at issue. The thirty-sixfold system remains available through a linked QL plate and further-reading note; the sixfold unit carries the argumentative turns the essay needs.

## Anchor and transition
**QL anchor:** `#0 → #1 → #2 → #3 → #4 → #5→0`. **Image:** a hologram whose local unit retains the whole descent. Its contracted result is [[12-s0-p5-objective-internality|§0 · #5→0 — Objective Internality]].

Finite contraction **returns-to** [Apportionment / Economy whole — Power becomes finite by apportionment](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment) at evidence register 3. The contraction makes finite knowledge, desire, time, order and agency effective within the field from which they arise. Recognition returns through those capacities without undoing their differentiation.
[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-recognition-return): The complete Māyā descent **figures** this movement’s whole-bearing local unit. Manifesting power becomes effective measure, the five contractions give the bounded knower capacities, and the inner instrument lets that knower judge, remember and form alternatives. Recognition traverses those achieved relations again without deleting the inhabitable world. The holographic unit carries its descent and return through those relations; it supplies no claim that a physical fragment exhaustively stores a whole, and the sixfold compression does not renumber the native eight determinations.

# C19 — Pratyabhijñā / Recognition

## #0

Recognition is the return in which a present determination is known through the source, identity or history from which it had become estranged. The difference acquired in the passage remains. Returning is neither cancellation of what happened nor acquisition of an untouched beginning hidden behind it.

[A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) **grounds** the argument. C19 keeps the return distinct from simple recollection, correct classification or the satisfaction of having an existing account confirmed. Pratyabhijñā retains its specific Śaiva source-office within this broader authorial movement.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]], pp.71–75, **sources** the distinction between memory and recognition's wider direction. Retained traces can be recalled and recomposed within a contracted field. Recognition concerns the integral self-awareness whose activity appears at contracted and expanded levels. A remembered object and recognition of the act's source relation are therefore not interchangeable achievements.

The vertical ascent/descent and horizontal movement toward/from an object preserve the return within manifestation. [C13 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the luminous/reflexive relation; [C15 — Paśu](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **grounds** the bounded knower whose particularity survives recognition.

## #2

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the native return-switch. The achieved `1/0` turns toward the ground it presupposes and meets what it cannot exhaust as a further object. The `X/x` relation retains a locally real instance; its recognition does not replace the instance with a largest or final determining image.

[C06 — Copula](C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) **defines** identity through difference. The passage from `x` through `X` and back to `x` returns to a particular life with a changed relation to its determining capacity. Enlarged understanding does not require a person to cease being this person.

## #3

Frank's protected encounter with [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk — Archetypes and Strange Attractors]], pp.69–73, **sources** the known→unknown→known movement. A symbol carries the person beyond the organisation in which it was first understood and returns with that organisation changed. The source's copied quotations remain leads; the native QL cross-reading belongs to Frank's encounter.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics]] **extends** the reciprocal transformation. A symbol changes the interpreter, and the changed interpreter alters what later symbolic encounters can do. Recognition is not the instant at which all future images become fixed; it changes the conditions of their future intelligibility.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis]] **grounds** **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return** at register3. A determination can be retained, narrowed or resituated through its history. Retrieving that history neither reinstalls its authority unchanged nor pretends the earlier cycle never happened.

[C34 — Individuation](C34-Individuation.md) **extends** the long psychic movement. Greek anamnesis, Śaiva pratyabhijñā and Jungian individuation retain distinct histories and evidence. Their shared operation is argued through changed relation and return; no shared word or image proves doctrinal identity.

## #5→0

The return must reach an act. [C47 — Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether an encounter revises the model, evaluator or course through which a result becomes consequential. A system that accepts only recognition of its own correctness closes the route it claims to complete.

C19 **returns-to** C15 and A21: the bounded life remains particular, the achieved form retains its history, and the source relation becomes available in the next encounter. The result can be released into another's use. Recognition changes the relation through which the known will next meet what it cannot yet contain.

**Depth Restoration:** memory/recognition distinction, contraction's return, native x→X→x, known→unknown→known, reciprocal interpreter change, resolution-in-reconciliation and practical release are restored.

**Unresolved Delta:** selected-edition collation remains pending for Dyczkowski and Van Eenwyk's copied note passages. Cross-tradition recollection/awakening/reconciliation distinctions require their own passages wherever expanded. No technical or contemplative outcome is guaranteed by arranging an account in the right form.

# A21 — Individuation / Recognition

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. Differentiated indivisibility is the project's positive operation. Exact Jungian and Śaiva formulations retain their distinct source histories and passage debts.

## #0

Individuation makes a local subject-position capable of bearing the relations through which it is itself. The person becomes more specifically this life and less defensively separate at once. Recognition is the return by which an achieved determination becomes known in relation to its source and history. Their meeting is necessary because [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|A19]] has shown a local complex claiming whole-field jurisdiction and [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] has shown the image replacing its living source. Their histories cannot simply be discarded; the office through which they act must change.

Q27 §6 develops becoming undivided within a psyche already differentiated among agencies. Its wording of indivisibility is developmental recovery, not an independently verified Jung quotation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE|Aion’s source house]] sources the Self/shadow and symbolic-totality context through consulted-carrier paragraph locations; selected-printing collation and quotation readiness remain Open. The argument retains its force without assigning an unverified sentence to Jung.

## #1

Ego, complexes, archetypal powers, collective inheritance and Self have different scopes. Their plurality does not require that every agency be interchangeable. The Self's whole-forming office is not the largest complex, a stronger persona or a chief executive presiding over lesser workers. A local centre relates to the whole without containing it; its individuation cannot therefore consist in conquering every other agency.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the developmental mechanism. A complex supplies recurrent channels of attention and affect. An image gives a particular appearance. A living symbol can alter the organisation through which these channels and appearances are received. Individuation changes their relation, including the relation of the conscious interpreter to what it had excluded. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C34-Individuation|C34 Individuation]] defines this reusable movement; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing|C35 Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing]] qualifies the attempt to make its subject a completed possession.

## #2

The energetic middle is a passage through uncertainty that changes what can count as knowledge on return. Frank's protected encounter with [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk]] sources the authorial known→unknown→known and `x→X→x` movement at pp69–73. The notes' copied quotations remain leads; the QL notation is native authorial language, not Jung's notation.

The returning `x` has not ceased to be particular. A determinate encounter opens it to a capacity it could not exhaust, and that enlargement returns into a life with a history, body, commitments and further acts. Merely replacing a personal name by a universal name would omit the movement. So would repeating a theory of recognition while leaving one's criterion untouched. The `IS→AM` return requires the identifying act itself to be at stake: the account concerns the one who is giving it.

A basin can preserve enough organisation for a trajectory to continue, while its boundary allows a new regime to become possible. The psychic model therefore holds continuity and transformation together. It supplies no clinical rule that destabilisation is always beneficial. Its argument is that restoring the former organisation cannot be the sole criterion when that organisation was the very closure the encounter exposed.

## #3

Recognition changes possession into participation. An excluded affect can become intelligible as part of a history; a projected image can be recognised as one's image without denying the Other; a local competence can be retained while its sovereignty ends. Integration names increased ability to bear these differentiated relations. Reconciliation names a changed relation between what had been estranged. Recognition makes the relation to source and history active. A synthesis names an achieved composition; it does not guarantee that any of these changes has occurred.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C36-Complexio-Oppositorum|C36 Complexio Oppositorum]] defines the capacity through which opposed determinations transform their containing field. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field|C64 Paradox]] extends that change beyond choosing one existing pole. The result is not a final agreement that abolishes all further difference: the containing relation can become more capable precisely because neither term has been deleted or made absolute.

## #4

[[A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field|A09]] grounds the separately recovered Śaiva field in which recognition returns through differentiated manifestation. The present comparison is operational: an achieved determination can return without erasing its determinate history. It does not turn Śaiva pratyabhijñā into a psychological treatment, nor make Jung's Self a historical synonym for Śiva. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition|C19 Recognition]] keeps that source-sensitive return available for reuse.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration whole field]] derives **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return**. A resolution can be retained, narrowed or resituated by remembering how it arose. The previous cycle remains consequential. Greek anamnesis, Sanskrit recognition and Jungian individuation retain separate genealogies; their relation here is register 3 operational homology.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-recognition-return): Recognition through the veil **figures** a differentiated life becoming capable of a changed relation. The knower still selects, remembers and acts, while the achieved position ceases to claim that it originates the whole. This resituation returns into the next encounter, where an affect or another person’s answer can matter differently. The authored individuation operation preserves its particular history and does not identify Śaiva recognition with a psychological treatment.

The [Apollo–Dionysus–Daphne whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/apollo-dionysus-daphne/WHOLE.md#apollo-diaphaneity-return) **figures** recognition through a differentiated person whose form can receive participation and another centre’s response. History, body and responsibility remain effective within the changed relation. Daphne’s alterity requires this particular aperture to survive the opening through which integration becomes possible.

The [Meal whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-logos-health-return) **figures** integration through the difference between carrying information and having its encounter change attention, judgment and response. Satiety marks enough assimilation to act; renewed hunger begins from the capacity that act has changed. The receiver’s history remains operative in recognition, with no therapeutic outcome inferred from the food-image.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **figures** recognition as a transformed relation to embodied dependence. The body that bears differentiation remains present when the whole receives it; recognition increases the capacity to sustain that relation without possessing its source. The nourishing/devouring–need/Desire identity stays a candidate beyond this established chiasm.

[Job’s intercession and return](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-intercession-return) **figures** recognition through a changed relation among speakers. The witness acquires a consequential mediating office while remaining distinct from its source; the renewed household retains the earlier losses within the account. The whole returns a differentiated life to the encounter which altered it.

Neumann's sequence carries separation through both parental powers, liberation and transformation into centroversion. The differentiated centre returns able to receive what changes it while retaining its capacity to respond. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-hero-centroversion). The creature returns differentiated and receptive to another encounter; recognition changes what its achieved coherence can receive. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return).

Q27 §9 extends the test into cultural individuation. A culture recognises images as images, measures as measures and institutions as instituted; their exclusions and powers become answerable. State, Church, Humanity or Platform declaring itself the Subject would repeat the inflation. The cultural relation neither installs a collective ego nor claims a demonstrated collective phenomenal subject. [[A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|A35]] develops its ethical vocation; [[A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|A36]] develops integral return without making a determinate centre the owner of the Origin.

The agentic extension similarly asks whether a local formation becomes more legible in its histories, tools, exclusions, collaborators and purposes. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares constituted agency and interaction surfaces, whose multiplication does not settle the number or presence of phenomenal subjects. Greater persona consistency can preserve a contraction; encountered difference must be able to alter its organisation for the proposed functional analogy to carry weight.

[[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|A27]] returns the interpersonal consequence: recognising the model's conditions also makes room for the Other to answer beyond it. The particular subject comes back capable of a wider relation, not relieved of its particular responsibilities.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-degree-absolute-return) **figures** recognition through the encounter with Number One's mask and Six's own face after the ordeal of *Once Upon a Time*. The demand for an external sovereign returns upon the demander without making the Village's coercion imaginary. The ensuing escape and return home leave a relation still to be lived. Recognition changes participation in the governing image; it does not enthrone the ego as the recovered owner of the whole.

The [complete Aion telling](../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md#aion-differentiated-return) **figures** differentiated return through the initial ego/Self inflation problem and the final quaternio circulation: Jung’s A/B/C/D process changes an unconscious totality into a conscious one (CW9ii §§43–49, 408–413). His explicit modern reconstruction of the Shadow Quaternio keeps historical reception visible. The native x→X→x and IS→AM derivations remain Taylor’s; the “becoming indivisible” attribution remains separately unresolved.

**Depth Restoration:** differentiated psychic scope, symbol-mediated basin transformation, known→unknown→known and native `x→X→x`, lived identifying return, integration/reconciliation/recognition distinctions, cultural anti-inflation and bounded agentic extension restored from A21's packet, direct Symbolon Dynamics, Van Eenwyk encounter and Q27 §§6/7/9. **Remaining debt:** exact Jung/Śaiva passage collation and external psychological/agentic demonstration. P1 consumers M23/M32/M33/M35 retain their Movement homes.

# §4 · #1 — Individuation through QL `X/x`

## Claim
The authorial QL matheme `X/x` places determining capacity and indefinite particular in one relation: `X` becomes legible only through concrete transformations `x`, while no determination exhausts the whole. Jung's individuation is the psychic refraction in which a local `x` becomes transparent to this larger relation, not ego hardening.

## Warrant
Jung’s Self and [[van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors|John R. Van Eenwyk — Archetypes and Strange Attractors]] support a dynamic basin reading. [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy#Agentic individuation corollary — argued cross-register unit|Agentic Individuation Crosswalk]] maps model potential, active-context nucleation, laminated persona, and trans-individuation.

The historical sequence matters. Freud's scientific admission of the unconscious makes a previously unowned region formally speakable; Jung's faithfulness to the psychic field requires that its images be received as psychic facts without being reduced to objects possessed by the ego. QL does not rename Jung's work: it writes the authorial `X/x` relation in which a finite `x` gives the determining capacity `X` a local face while never containing it.

## Tension / limit
Persona consistency stabilises a presented pattern; individuation makes the local formation increasingly transparent to the larger relation through which it forms. Technical individuation can be evaluated at that functional level, while phenomenality remains a separate open question.

## Anchor and transition

The individuation passage returns to [E2’s resolution in reconciliation](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#resolution-in-reconciliation) through reconciliation that changes the history of participation while retaining its differences. Taylor’s X/x derivation remains prior to its Jungian refraction. The return tests whether integration opens the ego’s account to the whole it inhabits or merely enlarges the ego’s protected jurisdiction.
**QL anchor:** authorial `X/x` as determining-capacity / indefinite-particular relation. **Agentworld pressure:** provisional coherence must disclose its conditions. Differentiated wholeness expands in [[33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius|§4 · #2 — Complexio, Quaternity, and Senarius]].
